what: Base body: clean-shaven human male in linen shorts (concept A), ~3.2k tris, Mixamo-style 24-bone rig. Armour and weapons are separate assets layered on top.
source: See docs/art-pipeline.md. Concept by Meshy text-to-image (nano-banana-2), image-to-3d (meshy-t2.5 smart topology, 3000 tris, a-pose), auto-rig at 1.8 m, preset animations.

clips.walk: Lean Forward Sprint in place (644), legs +25% (tools/build_extra_clips.py)
clips.idle_calm: Idle 12 (252) + Idle 02's (11) weight shift, arms back with bent elbows, breathing and sway (tools/build_extra_clips.py)

files.base_a_anim.glb: rigged + animated body, input of `import_meshy.py model` -> assets/hero.glb
files.armor_chain.glb: retexture with original UVs, input of `skin` -> assets/hero_skin_chain.png (--brighten 1.35)
files.anim2/hero_cand.glb: candidate clips on the same rig (Idle_02, Idle_9, Idle_12, Combat_Stance, Idle_10, four runs), input of tools/build_extra_clips.py

next_concepts.note: base body v2 candidates in the troll's painted style (meshy/hero2/concept_a..d.png); image-to-image with troll_b.png + base_a.png as references
